legend: A Macroscopy shows a well-circumscribed tumour with prominent multiple nodules separated by white septa. B The low-power scan of a histological slide shows a small type AB thymoma with infiltration of the mediastinal fat and small thymic remnants at the margin on the right side. The dark blue nodules represent a lymphocyte-rich type B–like component, separated by pale spindle cell areas.
Low magnification shows a nodular tumour with darker lymphocyte-rich and lighter lymphocyte-poor areas.
Higher magnification shows sharp transition between a lymphocyte-rich and a lymphocyte-poor area with spindle cell morphology of the epithelial cells.
This example shows more-diffuse distribution of lymphocytes over a background of spindle cells with focal nodules and rosetting.
CK19 immunostain highlights dense meshworks of epithelial cells.
Focal CD20 immunostaining in the neoplastic epithelium is a frequent observation in type A and AB thymomas.
H&E section shows spindle cell tumour with a moderate number of lymphocytes.

legend: TdT immunostaining highlights a moderate number of scattered immature T cells. If such areas occupy > 10% of the investigated tumour material, this tumour would qualify as type AB thymoma.
